overview_data: Paris, the iconic capital of France, is renowned worldwide for its romantic charm, extraordinary artistic heritage, classical architecture, world-class gastronomy, and vibrant cafe culture. Situated along the scenic Seine River in northern central France, the city boasts globally recognized landmarks like the Eiffel Tower, the Louvre Museum, Notre-Dame Cathedral, and the majestic Arc de Triomphe.

attractions.name: Eiffel Tower
attractions.highlights: Panoramic views of Paris, summit access, evening illuminations every hour, champagne bar on top.

attractions.name: Louvre Museum
attractions.highlights: Mona Lisa, Venus de Milo, Winged Victory of Samothrace, iconic glass pyramid entrance.

attractions.name: Musée d'Orsay
attractions.highlights: World's largest collection of impressionist and post-impressionist masterpieces by Monet, Van Gogh, and Degas inside a transformed Beaux-Arts railway station.

attractions.name: Arc de Triomphe & Champs-Élysées
attractions.highlights: Panoramic rooftop views looking down 12 radiating avenues, Tomb of the Unknown Soldier, luxury shopping along the Champs-Élysées.

attractions.name: Sainte-Chapelle
attractions.highlights: Breath-taking 13th-century Gothic chapel featuring 1,113 stained glass windows depicting biblical scenes.

attractions.name: Sacré-Cœur Basilica & Montmartre
attractions.highlights: White-domed hilltop basilica, Bohemian artist square (Place du Tertre), cobbled alleys, panoramic cityscape views.

activities.title: Seine River Sunset Cruise
activities.description: Board a glass-topped Bateau Mouche to glide past Paris' illuminated monuments while enjoying romantic acoustic music or an optional gourmet dinner.

activities.title: French Bakery & Pastry Workshop
activities.description: Learn the secret techniques of baking fresh butter croissants, pain au chocolat, and colorful French macarons with a professional Parisian chef.

activities.title: Le Marais Walking & Tasting Tour
activities.description: Stroll through historic aristocratic mansions, trendy fashion boutiques, falafel spots, artisanal cheese shops, and boutique wine bars.

activities.title: Luxembourg Gardens Picnic
activities.description: Relax like a Parisian beside the Medici Fountain in Paris' favorite 17th-century royal park with fresh baguettes, local cheeses, and wine.

best_time_to_visit.peak_season: June to August (Warm weather, lively outdoor terraces, bustling crowd)
best_time_to_visit.shoulder_season: April to May & September to October (Pleasant mild climate, colorful foliage, shorter queues)
best_time_to_visit.low_season: November to February (Cooler temperatures, festive holiday lights, discounted accommodations)

travel_information.public_transport: Paris Métro, RER trains, buses, and Vélib' bike-sharing network.
travel_information.airports: Charles de Gaulle (CDG) and Orly Airport (ORY).

faqs.question: How many days are ideal for visiting Paris for the first time?
faqs.answer: A stay of 4 to 5 days allows first-time visitors to see major landmarks like the Eiffel Tower, Louvre, and Montmartre without feeling rushed.

faqs.question: Is Paris easy to navigate using public transport?
faqs.answer: Yes, the Paris Métro is one of the most efficient metro systems in the world, connecting every quarter of the city within a short walking distance.

faqs.question: Do people speak English in Paris tourist areas?
faqs.answer: Yes, English is widely spoken in hotels, major tourist attractions, and restaurants. Starting a conversation with a polite 'Bonjour' is always appreciated.
